newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent steady after London gave up OPEC gains.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent steady after London gave up OPEC gains.

text.p: SIMEX Brent crude futures were untraded at midday in Asia but quoted in line with NYMEX values on ACCESS.
August was quoted at $17.85/$17.98 per barrel, with value seen at $17.90 as the market tracks a modest up tick on ACCESS.
August NYMEX crude prices on ACCESS were last traded at $19.14 per barrel, up five cents from New York, where the contract fell 43 cents to settle at $19.09.
London August Brent fell 37 to $17.85 on Thursday.
Brokers said the markets fell overnight as initial bullishness over OPEC pledges to abide by quotas gave way to scepticism that the oil group could keep members in line.
One broker said the Brent market now has fallen back into its previous trading range of $17.50-$18.00 and he said he expected further sideways action short term.
